C1.worst_defect: Four buttons of near-equal weight ("Live demo", "Quick start", "Try with your store", "GitHub") wrap 2+2 on the phone, and the hero image of the till below them is too small to read at 390 px: the product names, cart lines and total can't be made out, so on a phone between customers I can't see what my staff would be looking at.

C2.worst_defect: The offline promise ("Sales made with the network off wait on the till", "Unsent orders ... wait on that device") never says what happens to unsent sales if that browser's data is cleared or the device breaks before it reconnects, and Limitations doesn't say either; that is the first risk I'd ask about.
C2.where: home.desktop.01 'Keeps selling offline'; text/troubleshooting.txt 'Refresh prices and stock'; text/limitations.txt

C4.worst_defect: At the till is all text with no pictures of the till, and the site's own hero screenshot doesn't match it: the screenshot shows "Add charge" and "Checkout €59.59" buttons, while At the till says "Choose Pay cash, Pay by card or Split in the cart" and never mentions Add charge, custom items or shipping (which Plugin setup says 0.3.0 added).

overall_worst.defect: Refunds are plainly listed as "not yet", but no page tells staff what to do when a customer brings something back today. A returned item at the counter is the first moment where my staff would be stuck, and neither At the till nor Limitations gives a workaround or says how it affects the drawer count and Z report.
